result.summary: Found several layout and content issues: truncated restaurant names in the horizontal carousel, overlapping delivery badges on food images, and a partially cut-off promo card at the bottom.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure carousel cards allocate enough width/height so full names display without clipping.

issues.description: White delivery-time badges (e.g. '15–25 min', '20–30 min') overlap the food images and sit awkwardly on top of the illustrations, reducing visual clarity.
issues.suggestion: Reposition badges below the image or use a consistent overlay style with better contrast and padding so they don't obscure key parts of the artwork.

issues.description: Category chip row ends with a partially visible empty/white pill on the far right, which looks like a broken or incomplete filter control.
issues.suggestion: Ensure only valid category chips are rendered, or hide incomplete trailing items when they aren't part of the intentional peek-scroll pattern.

issues.description: Promo banner and section cards use heavy rounded corners and overlapping decorative circles that can make text feel cramped against the edges on smaller widths.
issues.suggestion: Increase internal padding on the green promo card and verify text doesn't sit too close to decorative background shapes.
